attBesluta.text: Happy with this product, is looks just as the pictures. It arrived within a week in good condition. It was easy to setup (there is very little needed) and what normally took us 2 hours to do with our Kenwood sausage stuffer, took us +/-20 minutes. We were able to stuff 5kg of sausage meat using the 30mm nozzle. This is so much easier and more fun. Its quite easy to clean. Pity it isn't dishwasher safe. I'm glad I went with this size as I there was another model for a similar price that was much larger, which I was tempted to get. But as I am a novice, the smaller device made more sense.
Really great product - very well made and a pleasure to use.
Good product and better than most for the price

Bought this for over the sink storage in my garrage. Excellent packaging and really easy to assemble and install by myself. The quality is really good for the price. In the past I paid more for hanging partical board shop cabinets that were not this nice, and held less weight.
I'm actually impress of the quality for the price, I'll bought more of those!

At first I was disappointed based on past purchases I have made with Vevor due to the lack of marking the parts for assembly. The only thing I had to go by was the diagram pictures which didn't help much due to multiple pieces looking the same. None of the holes were lining up so I adapted to the situation and rigged it together and then realized the back panels wasn't correct for hanging. So I took it apart and flipped the side panels etc... and all the holes lined up as they should even after drilling and boring out some of the original holes. All of my frustrations could have been avoided if only labeling tabs would have been put on the parts eliminating guessing. As far as the cabinet goes it is a nice product, and I will order more at some point. I just wish it was a little deeper because notebook binders will not fit straight in so the doors will close. It's perfect for storing things such as oil filters, spray cans and such. It does clean up the appearance of my workshop and makes it easier to find items that I need.
Very nice and sturdy cabinet! I’m very pleased with them (ordered 2) and recommend it to anyone who want a great looking unit in your garage.
great cabinets! The only issue I had was delivery.

I really can't describe how satisfied I am; the price is great, delivery was fast, the material seems high-quality, assembly is very simple, and they sent everything needed—the exact number of screws and nuts—and everything is perfect. Nothing but praise.
